forecasts.question: Will the Republican Party control the Senate after the 2026 Midterm elections?
forecasts.summary: Markets (Kalshi/Polymarket) give Democrats ~71-72% to win the Senate, and models range from 65% (DDHQ) to 78% (Poliwave). Republicans need to hold enough tossups (Iowa, Ohio, Kansas, Texas, Maine, Alaska, Nebraska) to keep 50 seats with the VP tiebreak, which leaves roughly a 27% chance.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.27 vs market 0.28: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will Republicans lose the Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Maine, Michigan, Ohio, and Texas Senate seats?
forecasts.summary: A YES needs Democrats or non-Republicans to win all seven seats, including toss-ups in Iowa and Kansas and long shots like Texas, Alaska and Ohio. Polling shows a Democratic-leaning environment with strongly correlated races, so I put the sweep at about 12%.

forecasts.question: 2026 Balance of Power: D Senate, D House
forecasts.summary: Prediction markets on Nov 1-2 put a Democratic sweep at about 68-71%, with the Democratic Senate at about 65-72% and the Democratic House at about 93-95%. The Senate is the binding constraint, and the election is one to two days away, so the market price is the best available estimate.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.69 vs market 0.72: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will the Democratic Party control the Senate after the 2026 Midterm elections?
forecasts.summary: Final model forecasts (DDHQ about 65%, Poliwave 78%) and late polls show Democrats leading all key Senate toss-ups, but mostly by narrow margins. Democrats need a net gain of four seats for 51, because Vance breaks a 50–50 tie. Correlated polling error could still flip the outcome.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.68 vs market 0.76: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will the Republicans win the Texas Senate race in 2026?
forecasts.summary: Final polls show Talarico (D) ahead by roughly 2.5–4 points on average, with a few ties and one Paxton lead. Texas polls have tended to overstate Democrats, and the state is still Republican-leaning, so the result is close to a toss-up with a slight Democratic edge.

forecasts.question: Will the Democrats win the Michigan Senate race in 2026?
forecasts.summary: El-Sayed (D) leads Rogers (R) by about 5 points in the final polling average, and Cook moved the race to Lean D on Nov 2. Decision Desk HQ gives El-Sayed 75%. Polling error and a close-race possibility keep this short of near-certainty.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.79 vs market 0.79: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will the Democrats win the Texas Senate race in 2026?
forecasts.summary: Final polls show Talarico (D) ahead of Paxton (R) by about 2.5 to 4 points on average, in a favorable midterm environment for Democrats and against a weak GOP nominee. Texas's Republican lean and a history of polls overstating Democrats keep this well short of certain.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.68 vs market 0.74: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will Republicans win Iowa, and lose Alaska, Kansas, Maine, Michigan, Ohio, and Texas?
forecasts.summary: Final polls show Democrats leading in Alaska, Kansas, Maine, Michigan, Ohio and Texas, with Iowa a tie. The market needs Republicans to win only Iowa while losing all six others, which is a narrow and unlikely combination because the races are correlated. I estimate roughly 4%.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.04 vs market 0.11: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will the Republicans win the Michigan Senate race in 2026?
forecasts.summary: El-Sayed (D) leads Rogers (R) by about 4-6 points in polling averages entering Election Day, with most late polls showing him ahead. Polling error and some late tightening leave Rogers a real chance, but he is a clear underdog.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.20 vs market 0.20: agrees with market

forecasts.question: 2026 Balance of Power: R Senate, D House
forecasts.summary: Election Day forecasts give Democrats about 84–99% to win the House and about 65–88% to win the Senate. A Republican Senate with a Democratic House is therefore roughly a 10–21% outcome, and I estimate about 18%. No results were available yet.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.18 vs market 0.17: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will the Republicans win the Texas governor race in 2026?
forecasts.summary: Abbott leads polling averages by about 2 points, though the final NYT/Siena and AtlasIntel polls showed Hinojosa slightly ahead. Texas polls have tended to understate Republicans, and Abbott has a large money advantage, so he is a moderate favorite. No results were available yet.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.73 vs market 0.64: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will the Republicans win the Florida governor race in 2026?
forecasts.summary: Election Day is today, so there are no results yet. Donalds (R) leads Jolly (D) by about 4 points in the polling average, and the race is rated Lean Republican by the major forecasters. He also has a large money advantage, though a tightening race and a Democratic-leaning national environment leave real upset risk.

forecasts.question: Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through November 7?
forecasts.summary: No direct Israel-Iran strikes appear to have occurred since June, and Trump is signalling a preference for a deal. But a post-midterm US-Israeli strike is actively being planned and Netanyahu is pushing for it, so there is meaningful tail risk within the 4-day window.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.82 vs market 0.81: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through November 15?
forecasts.summary: Strike planning by the US and Israel is at a peak right after the US midterms, and Netanyahu is lobbying hard. But Trump has repeatedly delayed strikes, says he is in no rush, and talks are reportedly progressing. The last confirmed direct Israel–Iran exchange I found was June 7–8, and the market needs an actual Israeli or Iranian strike that lands in the other country within about 12 days.
forecasts.decision: AI 0.68 vs market 0.59: agrees with market

forecasts.question: Will Elon Musk post 300-319 tweets from October 30 to November 6, 2026?
forecasts.summary: Recent weekly counts imply roughly 330–350 posts for the window, and election week could push it higher. The 300–319 bucket sits below that central estimate, so it is plausible but not the favorite. I couldn't find the live count for this window.
forecasts.decision: AI confidence low: not trading on it

forecasts.question: Will Gemini Carbon be released between November 9 and November 15, 2026?
forecasts.summary: Carbon was announced Oct 28 but is still limited to Fairwind cyber defenders, with no public date. Argon's 13-day gap from defenders-only to public would land near Nov 10, but Google says it is iterating on guardrails and is in US government pre-release testing, so timing is very uncertain. A release before Nov 9 or after Nov 15 would resolve NO.
